english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for relevance or a connection between things.

exampleSentences.english: This matter has no bearing on us.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 gin6 si6 tung4 ngo5 dei6 mou5 gwaan1 hai6

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose word for a connection or affiliation with someone or something.

exampleSentences.english: I don't have much association with this company.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我同呢間公司冇乜關係。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 mou5 mat1 gwaan1 hai6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a connection or relationship between people, things, events, or ideas.

exampleSentences.english: These two things have a link.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 loeng5 gin6 si6 jau5 gwaan1 hai6 gaa3
